text:
Use with caution / monitor. 

When clarithromycin is co-administered with atorvastatin, plasma levels of atorvastatin are significantly increased due to the inhibition of CYP3A4 and/or transporters [atorvastatin:drug_interactions:5]. Because of this increased exposure, the dose of atorvastatin should not exceed 20 mg daily [clarithromycin:warnings_and_cautions:8]. Exceeding this limit raises the risk of adverse skeletal muscle effects, including myopathy and rhabdomyolysis [clarithromycin:warnings_and_cautions:8].
